cues.text: A breathtaking scientific revolution is taking place – biotechnology has been progressing
cues.en: A breathtaking scientific revolution is taking place – biotechnology has been progressing
cues.zh: 一場令人嘆為觀止的科學革命正在發生 生物技術以驚人的速度

cues.text: at stunning speed, giving us the tools to eventually gain control over biology.
cues.en: at stunning speed, giving us the tools to eventually gain control over biology.
cues.zh: 一直在進步 為我們提供工具 最終得以控制生物學

cues.text: On the one hand solving the deadliest diseases while also creating viruses more dangerous
cues.en: On the one hand solving the deadliest diseases while also creating viruses more dangerous
cues.zh: 一方面解決最致命的病毒 同時也製造更危險的病毒

cues.text: than nuclear bombs, able to devastate humanity.
cues.en: than nuclear bombs, able to devastate humanity.
cues.zh: 比核彈，更能夠摧毀人類

cues.text: What is going on?
cues.en: What is going on?
cues.zh: 這是怎麼回事?

cues.text: Biotechnology is increasingly everywhere.
cues.en: Biotechnology is increasingly everywhere.
cues.zh: 生物技術越來越無處不在

cues.text: The cotton in your clothes, the vegetables you eat, your dog.

cues.zh: 衣服裡的棉花、你吃的蔬菜、你的狗

cues.text: Humans manipulate living things.
cues.en: Humans manipulate living things.
cues.zh: 人類操縱生物

cues.text: We use bacteria to produce insulin, connect prosthetics directly with our brains and make
cues.en: We use bacteria to produce insulin, connect prosthetics directly with our brains and make
cues.zh: 我們使用細菌產生胰島素，直接連接義肢與大腦

cues.text: industrial enzymes to produce paper.
cues.en: industrial enzymes to produce paper.
cues.zh: 生產工業酶來製造紙張。

cues.text: Gene therapy creates cures to previously untreatable diseases while we are working on food crops
cues.en: Gene therapy creates cures to previously untreatable diseases while we are working on food crops
cues.zh: 基因療法治癒了以前無法治癒的疾病 同時我們研究糧食作物

cues.text: resistant to climate change.
cues.en: resistant to climate change.
cues.zh: 抵禦氣候變化

cues.text: Our mastery over biology has been speeding up so much that within weeks of the first
cues.en: Our mastery over biology has been speeding up so much that within weeks of the first
cues.zh: 我們對生物學的掌握一直在加速 如此之多，以至於在前幾周內的

cues.text: Covid 19 case, the unknown coronavirus was broken down in laboratories and analysed.
cues.en: Covid 19 case, the unknown coronavirus was broken down in laboratories and analysed.
cues.zh: 新冠肺炎病例，未知的冠狀病毒在實驗室中被分解並進行分析

cues.text: Scientists generated a copy of its genetic material to create a vaccine that was ready
cues.en: Scientists generated a copy of its genetic material to create a vaccine that was ready
cues.zh: 科學家生成基因的副本 在大流行開始幾個月後

cues.text: for testing months after the pandemic began.
cues.en: for testing months after the pandemic began.
cues.zh: 製造疫苗並進行測試

cues.text: Something unthinkable a decade ago.
cues.en: Something unthinkable a decade ago.
cues.zh: 十年前無法想像的事情

cues.text: Where is all this sudden progress coming from?
cues.en: Where is all this sudden progress coming from?
cues.zh: 這些突如其來的進步從何而來?

cues.text: Well, it's complicated.
cues.en: Well, it's complicated.
cues.zh: 嗯，這很複雜

cues.text: But in a nutshell: really expensive things got cheap and knowledge of how to do
cues.en: But in a nutshell: really expensive things got cheap and knowledge of how to do
cues.zh: 但簡而言之:非常貴的東西變便宜了，製作令人驚艷事物

cues.text: impressive things spread freely.
cues.en: impressive things spread freely.
cues.zh: 的知識自由傳播

cues.text: The Human Genome Project starting in 1990 was the first major attempt to read human
cues.en: The Human Genome Project starting in 1990 was the first major attempt to read human
cues.zh: 始於1990年的人類基因組計畫 是第一次嘗試去閱讀人類的

cues.text: DNA in its entirety. 13 years and $3 billion later, it was complete.
cues.en: DNA in its entirety. 13 years and $3 billion later, it was complete.
cues.zh: 整個去氧核醣核酸。花了13年和30億美元來完成

cues.text: By then the cost of decoding a human genome had fallen to about $100 million.

cues.text: Today it is 100,000 times cheaper, costing only about $1000.
cues.en: Today it is 100,000 times cheaper, costing only about $1000.
cues.zh: 如今便宜十萬倍 成本只有大約1000美元

cues.text: How is that possible?
cues.en: How is that possible?
cues.zh: 這怎麼可能?

cues.text: Converting DNA into computer data and then studying it used to be a super tedious process,
cues.en: Converting DNA into computer data and then studying it used to be a super tedious process,
cues.zh: 將DNA轉化為電腦數據，然後研究它，曾經是一個超級乏味的過程

cues.text: taking expert humans around 3 years of manual work.
cues.en: taking expert humans around 3 years of manual work.
cues.zh: 需要人類專家手動操作約3年

cues.text: Today it takes about two weeks and is almost completely automated.
cues.en: Today it takes about two weeks and is almost completely automated.
cues.zh: 如今大約需要兩周時間，且幾乎完全自動化

cues.text: Biotechnology has gone from something restricted to the best and well-funded laboratories staffed
cues.en: Biotechnology has gone from something restricted to the best and well-funded laboratories staffed
cues.zh: 生物技術已經從受到限制 轉變為最好和資金充足的實驗室

cues.text: by the world's top experts, to something affordable enough for hundreds of thousands of people
cues.en: by the world's top experts, to something affordable enough for hundreds of thousands of people
cues.zh: 擁有世界頂級專家，負擔得起數十萬人臨時地工作

cues.text: to casually work on.
cues.en: to casually work on.
cues.zh: 擁有世界頂級專家，負擔得起數十萬人臨時地工作

cues.text: What has sped up the process even more is that information in the field is shared
cues.en: What has sped up the process even more is that information in the field is shared
cues.zh: 進一步加快這一進程的是 信息共用廣泛而自由

cues.text: widely and freely.
cues.en: widely and freely.
cues.zh: 進一步加快這一進程的是 信息共用廣泛而自由

cues.text: Cutting-edge discoveries now take just about a year to be copied in laboratories around the world,
cues.en: Cutting-edge discoveries now take just about a year to be copied in laboratories around the world,
cues.zh: 現在最新的發現只需一年左右 就在世界各地的實驗室被複製

cues.text: a few years for anyone with a biology background to work out, and a bit over a decade
cues.en: a few years for anyone with a biology background to work out, and a bit over a decade
cues.zh: 幾年後 讓有生物學背景的人實作，以及十多年後

cues.text: for high school students to experiment with them in schools.
cues.en: for high school students to experiment with them in schools.
cues.zh: 十年後供高中生在學校實驗

cues.text: Imagine that your local computer repair shop could build a pristine Iphone 11 with just
cues.en: Imagine that your local computer repair shop could build a pristine Iphone 11 with just
cues.zh: 想像一下，您當地的電腦維修店可以做出全新的iPhone11

cues.text: the parts lying around, and that teenagers are asked to build a new Iphone 5 for homework.
cues.en: the parts lying around, and that teenagers are asked to build a new Iphone 5 for homework.
cues.zh: 僅用到周圍的部分，青少年的回家作業是做出新的iPhone5

cues.text: Not a crappy homemade version, the real thing.
cues.en: Not a crappy homemade version, the real thing.
cues.zh: 不是蹩腳的自製版本，是真正厲害的

cues.text: This is what is going on right now in biotechnology – a true revolution.
cues.en: This is what is going on right now in biotechnology – a true revolution.
cues.zh: 這就是生物技術現在正在發生的事情--一場真正的革命

cues.text: We are adding knowledge at unprecedented rates, while things get ever faster and cheaper to do.
cues.en: We are adding knowledge at unprecedented rates, while things get ever faster and cheaper to do.
cues.zh: 我們正在以前所未有的速度增加知識，事情做起來越來越快，越來越便宜

cues.text: This speed means we can expect even more wonderful things for humanity.
cues.en: This speed means we can expect even more wonderful things for humanity.
cues.zh: 這種速度意味著我們可以期待更多精彩的東西

cues.text: Lifesaving treatments, miracle crops and solutions to problems we can’t even imagine right now.
cues.en: Lifesaving treatments, miracle crops and solutions to problems we can’t even imagine right now.
cues.zh: 救命的療法、神奇的作物和解決難以想像問題的方法

cues.text: But unfortunately progress cuts both ways.
cues.en: But unfortunately progress cuts both ways.
cues.zh: 但不幸的是，進步是雙向的

cues.text: What can be used for good, can also be used for bad, by accident or on purpose.
cues.en: What can be used for good, can also be used for bad, by accident or on purpose.
cues.zh: 可以產生正面影響的事物，當然也可以因偶然或故意，用於負面

cues.text: For all the good biotech will do for us, in the near future it also could easily kill
cues.en: For all the good biotech will do for us, in the near future it also could easily kill
cues.zh: 所有好的生物技術為我們做的一切

cues.text: many millions of people, in the worst case hundreds of millions.
cues.en: many millions of people, in the worst case hundreds of millions.
cues.zh: 在不久的將來，也可以輕易殺死數百萬，甚至數億人

cues.text: Worse than any nuclear bomb.
cues.en: Worse than any nuclear bomb.
cues.zh: 比任何核彈都嚴重

cues.text: The world just witnessed how fast the novel coronavirus spread.
cues.en: The world just witnessed how fast the novel coronavirus spread.
cues.zh: 世界剛剛見證了冠狀病毒傳播得有多快

cues.text: We still do not know for sure if it came from nature or was the result of an accidental leak
cues.en: We still do not know for sure if it came from nature or was the result of an accidental leak
cues.zh: 我們仍不確定它來自野外來或意外洩漏自研究冠狀病毒的實驗室

cues.text: from a lab working with corona viruses, that’s still subject to scientific debate.
cues.en: from a lab working with corona viruses, that’s still subject to scientific debate.
cues.zh: 我們仍不確定它來自野外來或意外洩漏自研究冠狀病毒的實驗室

cues.text: In the end at least 7 million people died.
cues.en: In the end at least 7 million people died.
cues.zh: 最終至少7百萬人死亡

cues.text: And this was still a relatively mild virus that didn’t cause serious disease in most of those infected.
cues.en: And this was still a relatively mild virus that didn’t cause serious disease in most of those infected.
cues.zh: 這僅是一種相對溫和的病毒 沒有在大多數感染者中引起嚴重的病症

cues.text: But that might change in the future.
cues.en: But that might change in the future.
cues.zh: 但將來可能不同

cues.text: Wherever the last pandemic came from, the next one might very well be our own fault
cues.en: Wherever the last pandemic came from, the next one might very well be our own fault
cues.zh: 無論上一次大流行來自何處，下一個很可能是我們自己的錯

cues.text: – in a sense, many things going on in biotechnology could lead to this.
cues.en: – in a sense, many things going on in biotechnology could lead to this.

cues.text: Most of all how easy it is to work with dangerous viruses.
cues.en: Most of all how easy it is to work with dangerous viruses.
cues.zh: 最重要的，研究危險的病毒如此容易

cues.text: Thousands of scientists can simply order the genetic data of infectious virus samples online
cues.en: Thousands of scientists can simply order the genetic data of infectious virus samples online
cues.zh: 成千上萬的科學家可以在線上輕鬆訂購傳染性病毒的遺傳數據來做實驗

cues.text: to experiment with them.
cues.en: to experiment with them.
cues.zh: 成千上萬的科學家可以在線上輕鬆訂購傳染性病毒的遺傳數據來做實驗

cues.text: Assembling these into an artificial virus in 2023 costs about as much as a new car,

cues.zh: 到2023年，以這些組裝成人造病毒 含所有實驗室設備

cues.text: including all the lab equipment.
cues.en: including all the lab equipment.
cues.zh: 成本大約與一輛新車一樣多

cues.text: At the same time, other scientists are trying to find viruses that hide in nature,
cues.en: At the same time, other scientists are trying to find viruses that hide in nature,

cues.text: like in wild bats or monkeys.
cues.en: like in wild bats or monkeys.
cues.zh: 例如在野生蝙蝠或猴子身上

cues.text: There are probably plenty of potentially deadly pandemics out there.
cues.en: There are probably plenty of potentially deadly pandemics out there.
cues.zh: 那裡可能有許多潛在的致命流行病

cues.text: Virus hunters take samples back to the lab to learn whether the newly discovered viruses
cues.en: Virus hunters take samples back to the lab to learn whether the newly discovered viruses
cues.zh: 病毒獵人將樣本帶回實驗室 以得知新發現的病毒是否

cues.text: are likely to spread in humans and catalogue the danger.
cues.en: are likely to spread in humans and catalogue the danger.
cues.zh: 很可能在人類和動物中傳播 並記錄危險性

cues.text: When a biologist discovers a new virus, they usually publish its genetic data to the public.
cues.en: When a biologist discovers a new virus, they usually publish its genetic data to the public.
cues.zh: 當生物學家發現新病毒時，他們通常會向公眾公布其基因數據

cues.text: Journals are eager to share descriptions of potentially dangerous viruses.
cues.en: Journals are eager to share descriptions of potentially dangerous viruses.
cues.zh: 期刊渴望分享 具潛在危險的病毒的描述

cues.text: Other labs go further and make viruses more dangerous.
cues.en: Other labs go further and make viruses more dangerous.
cues.zh: 其他實驗室更加深入，使病毒更危險

cues.text: They combine and mutate different viruses to understand which mutations make them more
cues.en: They combine and mutate different viruses to understand which mutations make them more
cues.zh: 他們組合和變異不同的病毒 了解哪些突變使它們

cues.text: likely to spread between humans or make them deadlier than their original forms.
cues.en: likely to spread between humans or make them deadlier than their original forms.
cues.zh: 更可能在人類之間傳播或變得更致命

cues.text: And again, these results are shared freely.
cues.en: And again, these results are shared freely.
cues.zh: 同樣，這些結果是自由共用的

cues.text: All while synthetic DNA and equipment to rebuild these viruses are sold online to anyone
cues.en: All while synthetic DNA and equipment to rebuild these viruses are sold online to anyone
cues.zh: 合成DNA和重建病毒的設備 在線上出售給任何人

cues.text: without any or very little tracking.
cues.en: without any or very little tracking.
cues.zh: 幾乎沒有追蹤

cues.text: As the tools of biotechnology get ever cheaper and easy to use and the data on
cues.en: As the tools of biotechnology get ever cheaper and easy to use and the data on
cues.zh: 隨著生物技術工具變得愈加便宜且易於使用

cues.text: dangerous viruses keeps multiplying, it is only a matter of time before a well-meaning scientist shares
cues.en: dangerous viruses keeps multiplying, it is only a matter of time before a well-meaning scientist shares
cues.zh: 危險病毒的數據大幅增加，總有一天 好心科學家分享

cues.text: blueprints for the equivalent nuclear bomb of viruses, a superbug that will cause millions of deaths
cues.en: blueprints for the equivalent nuclear bomb of viruses, a superbug that will cause millions of deaths
cues.zh: 效果如同核彈的病毒藍圖，一種將導致數百萬人死亡的超級病菌

cues.text: – and someone uses it.
cues.en: – and someone uses it.
cues.zh: -然後有人使用它

cues.text: Maybe because they have bad intentions, maybe because they are irresponsible or sloppy.
cues.en: Maybe because they have bad intentions, maybe because they are irresponsible or sloppy.
cues.zh: 也許是因為他們有惡意，也許因為他們不負責任或馬虎

cues.text: We are creating an environment in which it is increasingly easy for anyone to create
cues.en: We are creating an environment in which it is increasingly easy for anyone to create
cues.zh: 我們正在營造一個環境 讓任何人都越來越容易

cues.text: a weaponized virus in their backyard.
cues.en: a weaponized virus in their backyard.
cues.zh: 在自家後院創建病毒武器

cues.text: This is scary.
cues.en: This is scary.
cues.zh: 這太可怕了

cues.text: The world would be plunged into an unending crisis as new pandemics pop up year after year
cues.en: The world would be plunged into an unending crisis as new pandemics pop up year after year
cues.zh: 世界將陷入無止境的危機，新的大流行病年復一年地出現

cues.text: or all at once – killing large parts of the world’s population, doing unimaginable
cues.en: or all at once – killing large parts of the world’s population, doing unimaginable
cues.zh: 或一次殺死大量的世界人口

cues.text: damage to civilisation as a whole, and possibly undoing centuries of progress.
cues.en: damage to civilisation as a whole, and possibly undoing centuries of progress.
cues.zh: 造成對文明難以想像的損害，甚至可能 破壞了幾世紀的進步

cues.text: It’s not the first time we’ve faced a challenge like this and we are not helpless
cues.en: It’s not the first time we’ve faced a challenge like this and we are not helpless
cues.zh: 這不是我們第一次面對這樣的挑戰，我們並非無助

cues.text: – think of nuclear technology.
cues.en: – think of nuclear technology.
cues.zh: -想想核技術

cues.text: Something extremely powerful and dangerous with huge upsides and downsides.
cues.en: Something extremely powerful and dangerous with huge upsides and downsides.
cues.zh: 極其強大又危險的東西 有巨大的優點和缺點

cues.text: Nuclear energy was born from weapon programs, so its creators were always aware of the potential
cues.en: Nuclear energy was born from weapon programs, so its creators were always aware of the potential
cues.zh: 核能誕生於武器計畫，所以它的創造者總是意識到

cues.text: for their knowledge to be abused.
cues.en: for their knowledge to be abused.
cues.zh: 他們的知識被濫用的潛能

cues.text: From the very beginning it was clear that knowledge in this field and access to the

cues.zh: 從一開始就很明確 該領域的知識和技術的獲得

cues.text: technology needed to be handled with utmost care.
cues.en: technology needed to be handled with utmost care.
cues.zh: 需要用最大程度的謹慎來處理

cues.text: So a lot of effort has gone into making sure no radioactive material disappears from sight

cues.zh: 因此，很多努力投入在確保沒有任何放射性物質離開視線

cues.text: or that countries don’t try to hide weapons development behind energy programs.
cues.en: or that countries don’t try to hide weapons development behind energy programs.
cues.zh: 或者國家不試圖在能源計畫背後發展武器

cues.text: The result hasn’t been perfect, but considering the 411 nuclear power stations running today,

cues.zh: 結果並不完美，但考慮到正在運行的411座核電站

cues.text: we’ve been very successful.
cues.en: we’ve been very successful.
cues.zh: 我們非常成功

cues.text: Likewise, no researcher would think to share data on how to turn common laboratory equipment
cues.en: Likewise, no researcher would think to share data on how to turn common laboratory equipment
cues.zh: 同樣，沒有研究人員會想將如何把普通實驗室設備變成炸彈製造機的資訊

cues.text: into bomb-making machines on the internet.
cues.en: into bomb-making machines on the internet.
cues.zh: 同樣，沒有研究人員會想將如何把普通實驗室設備變成炸彈製造機的資訊

cues.text: There is no reason we could not handle the really dangerous aspects of biotechnology
cues.en: There is no reason we could not handle the really dangerous aspects of biotechnology
cues.zh: 我們沒有理由不能以類似的方式

cues.text: in a similar way!
cues.en: in a similar way!
cues.zh: 處理生物技術危險的方面

cues.zh: 專家想出了三點:

cues.text: First we need to delay the next deadly pandemic by getting a grip on how we treat dangerous viruses.
cues.en: First we need to delay the next deadly pandemic by getting a grip on how we treat dangerous viruses.
cues.zh: 首先，我們需要掌握如何處理危險病毒 以推遲下一次致命的大流行

cues.text: Their genetic data should be treated as an infohazard: information that poses a danger
cues.en: Their genetic data should be treated as an infohazard: information that poses a danger
cues.zh: 它們的遺傳數據應被視為資訊危害:

cues.text: to society if it is shared without care.
cues.en: to society if it is shared without care.
cues.zh: 如果隨便地分享，將會為社會帶來危險的資訊

cues.text: And if you do, you should be tracked, so it becomes much harder for the wrong people
cues.en: And if you do, you should be tracked, so it becomes much harder for the wrong people
cues.zh: 如果這麼做，應該要被追蹤

cues.text: to access the really spicy stuff.
cues.en: to access the really spicy stuff.
cues.zh: 所以對不適合的人來說，取得辛辣的東西更加困難

cues.text: The next step is detecting the danger by becoming aware which viruses are present among us
cues.en: The next step is detecting the danger by becoming aware which viruses are present among us
cues.zh: 下一步，偵測危險 了解目前人群中有什麼病毒

cues.text: and are spreading explosively between humans.
cues.en: and are spreading explosively between humans.
cues.zh: 在人與人之間快速傳播

cues.text: This could be as easy as having labs in population centres maintain virus detectors
cues.en: This could be as easy as having labs in population centres maintain virus detectors
cues.zh: 這可能就像在人口中心建造配備病毒偵測器的實驗室一樣簡單

cues.text: that monitor what is going on in the micro world.
cues.en: that monitor what is going on in the micro world.
cues.zh: 監控微觀世界中發生的事

cues.text: If we suddenly see certain microorganisms show up a lot in a short time, we can react quickly
cues.en: If we suddenly see certain microorganisms show up a lot in a short time, we can react quickly
cues.zh: 如果看到某些微生物短時間內大量出現，我們可以迅速反應並啟動對策

cues.text: and start counter measures.
cues.en: and start counter measures.
cues.zh: 如果看到某些微生物短時間內大量出現，我們可以迅速反應並啟動對策

cues.text: Which is the final step: Destroy.
cues.en: Which is the final step: Destroy.
cues.zh: 最後一步:銷毀

cues.text: We basically need to build a machine that is ready to destroy any pandemic threat
cues.en: We basically need to build a machine that is ready to destroy any pandemic threat
cues.zh: 我們基本上需要製造一台機器 準備好在任何流行病 有機會接管一切前摧毀它

cues.text: before it has a chance to take over.
cues.en: before it has a chance to take over.
cues.zh: 我們基本上需要製造一台機器 準備好在任何流行病 有機會接管一切前摧毀它

cues.text: We can do this with new tools that are being developed right now, like nanofilters
cues.en: We can do this with new tools that are being developed right now, like nanofilters
cues.zh: 我們可以使用正在開發的新工具來做到這一點

cues.text: that pull dangers out of the air we breathe or specialized UV lamps that just kill any virus
cues.en: that pull dangers out of the air we breathe or specialized UV lamps that just kill any virus
cues.zh: 如奈米過濾器，從我們呼吸的空氣中排除危險

cues.text: before it has a chance to jump from person to person.
cues.en: before it has a chance to jump from person to person.
cues.zh: 或用紫外線燈，可在病毒有機會傳播前殺死它們

cues.text: And of course, we need to get better at getting new vaccines faster than ever before in history.
cues.en: And of course, we need to get better at getting new vaccines faster than ever before in history.
cues.zh: 當然，我們需要用比過去任何時候更快的速度取得新疫苗

cues.text: If we do these three things, the chances are really good that we can avoid
cues.en: If we do these three things, the chances are really good that we can avoid
cues.zh: 如果做到這些，我們未來很有機會避免

cues.text: a catastrophic pandemic in the future.
cues.en: a catastrophic pandemic in the future.
cues.zh: 一場災難性的大流行

cues.text: Biotechnology,  like any exciting and powerful technology, is neither inherently good or bad.
cues.en: Biotechnology,  like any exciting and powerful technology, is neither inherently good or bad.
cues.zh: 生物技術，如同任何令人興奮又強大的技術，本質上不好也不壞

cues.text: It has the potential to be both in breathtaking ways.
cues.en: It has the potential to be both in breathtaking ways.
cues.zh: 它在兩方面都有驚人的潛力

cues.text: We have the chance to a future where we get to truly control biology  - our biology,
cues.en: We have the chance to a future where we get to truly control biology  - our biology,
cues.zh: 我們有機會在未來真正地掌握生物學

cues.text: the biology of the plants and animals around us – and the biology of the microworld.
cues.en: the biology of the plants and animals around us – and the biology of the microworld.
cues.zh: 我們的生物學、身邊動植物的生物學，微觀世界的生物學

cues.text: So let’s use it to create a future where we triumph over pandemics and diseases for good.
cues.en: So let’s use it to create a future where we triumph over pandemics and diseases for good.
cues.zh: 所以用它來創造一個成功控制大流行和疾病的美好未來!

cues.en: This video was supported by Open Philanthropy.
cues.zh: 這部影片由Open Philanthropy支持

cues.text: If you want to help and want to have a high impact on the world,
cues.en: If you want to help and want to have a high impact on the world,
cues.zh: 如果您想幫忙並大大影響世界

cues.text: check out the biorisk career guide from 80,000 hours,
cues.en: check out the biorisk career guide from 80,000 hours,

cues.text: a nonprofit organisation that helps people find careers

cues.text: that can tackle some of humanity's greatest problems in the most efficient way.
cues.en: that can tackle some of humanity's greatest problems in the most efficient way.

cues.zh: 我們在資訊欄放了連結和深入閱讀

cues.text: Aside from biorisk there are more guides to check out too!
cues.en: Aside from biorisk there are more guides to check out too!
cues.zh: 除了生物技術風險還有其他指導值得一看!

cues.text: Let us tell you about one of the most embarrassing moments in kurzgesagt history,
cues.en: Let us tell you about one of the most embarrassing moments in kurzgesagt history,
cues.zh: 告訴您一件我們做過最尷尬的事 是個很棒的故事

cues.text: it’s a pretty great story.
cues.en: it’s a pretty great story.
cues.zh: 告訴您一件我們做過最尷尬的事 是個很棒的故事

cues.text: A few years ago we posted an image of a fake evolutionary tree on social media.
cues.en: A few years ago we posted an image of a fake evolutionary tree on social media.
cues.zh: 幾年前我們在社群媒體上傳一張假的演化圖

cues.text: Just to post something nice, without thinking about it.
cues.en: Just to post something nice, without thinking about it.
cues.zh: 我們沒多考慮，只是想傳些好東西

cues.text: But we messed with the wrong birbs.
cues.en: But we messed with the wrong birbs.
cues.zh: 但我們惹錯鳥了

cues.text: Immediately we got thousands of  messages from you telling us how wrong it was, unscientific,
cues.en: Immediately we got thousands of  messages from you telling us how wrong it was, unscientific,
cues.zh: 一下子就有上千的訊息告訴我們那不正確、不科學

cues.text: bad.
cues.en: bad.
cues.zh: 太慘了

cues.text: We underestimate that you take everything that we put out into the world seriously and
cues.en: We underestimate that you take everything that we put out into the world seriously and
cues.zh: 我們了解到您認真看待我們給出的東西

cues.text: you set high standards for our research and fact-checking process.
cues.en: you set high standards for our research and fact-checking process.
cues.zh: 您以高標準檢視我們的研究和事實查核

cues.text: This hurt.
cues.en: This hurt.
cues.zh: 我們很受傷

cues.text: A lot.
cues.en: A lot.
cues.zh: 我們很受傷

cues.text: We wanted to be better than that.
cues.en: We wanted to be better than that.
cues.zh: 我們想做得比那更好

cues.en: So we deleted it and contacted experts and spent hundreds of hours on research and illustration

cues.text: Expert approved.
cues.en: Expert approved.
cues.zh: 有專家的認可

cues.text: We were extremely proud of the result – and since we had spent so much time on it,
cues.en: We were extremely proud of the result – and since we had spent so much time on it,
cues.zh: 我們對結果感到驕傲，因為我們花了如此多的時間

cues.text: we turned it into a poster.
cues.en: we turned it into a poster.
cues.zh: 我們把它做成海報

cues.en: And from that a new vision was born:
cues.zh: 新的展望出現

cues.zh: 我們想成為世界上最好的資訊圖表和科學海報商店

cues.en: Today we’ve designed almost 100 posters and sold over half a million copies
cues.zh: 如今我們已設計100張左右的海報並售出超過50萬份

cues.text: – every single one made with love, care and lots of attention to detail.
cues.en: – every single one made with love, care and lots of attention to detail.
cues.zh: 每份都是愛、在乎、與對細節的重視

cues.text: All because you guys challenged us.
cues.en: All because you guys challenged us.
cues.zh: 這一切都因您對我們發出挑戰

cues.text: Thank you so much for that and for supporting our weird ideas and our sometimes weird Merch.
cues.en: Thank you so much for that and for supporting our weird ideas and our sometimes weird Merch.
cues.zh: 非常感謝那件事與支持我們奇怪的點子、偶爾奇怪的商品

cues.text: Because of you we can continue to release our videos for free for everyone and drop
cues.en: Because of you we can continue to release our videos for free for everyone and drop
cues.zh: 因為您我們得以繼續免費為所有人製作影片，

cues.text: hundreds of hours into new concepts to spark curiosity in people all around the world.

cues.en: Thank you so, so much for being part of our vision – we literally couldn’t do it without you.
